hooks.command: in=$(cat); f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' <<<"$in"); case "$f" in */web/src/*) echo 'web/src changed — npm run test:ui must pass before this is done.' ;; esac; exit 0

in=$(cat); c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' <<<"$in"); if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq -- '(--add-label|--label)[ =][^ ]*loop:(go|build)'; then echo "Applying loop:go or loop:build is a human gate (gate 1 / gate 2). Refusing." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
